outgoing.name: Arctic Circle
outgoing.excerpt: Its thick plumage, heavily-feathered feet, and coloration render the Snowy Owl well-adapted for life north of the Arctic Circle.

outgoing.name: Canada
outgoing.excerpt: Snowy Owls winter south through Canada and northernmost Eurasia, with irruptions occurring further south in some years.

outgoing.name: China
outgoing.excerpt: They have been reported as far south as Texas, Georgia, the American Gulf states, southern Russia, northern China and even the Caribbean.

outgoing.name: Scotland
outgoing.excerpt: Between 1967 and 1975, Snowy Owls bred on the remote island of Fetlar in the Shetland Isles north of Scotland, UK.
